---
name: Site stopped working
about: A site that used to answer now fails itda check or returns something else
title: "<site>: "
labels: site, bug
---

## Site

The site name from `itda ls`, and whether it came from `itda setup`, a
ready-made definition in `sites/`, or a software template.

## What itda says

The output of `itda check <site>` and, if you ran it, `itda refresh <site>`.
Remove credentials and private data.

```
$ itda check <site>
```

## What changed on the site, if you know

A new version, a redesign, a new sign-in page.
